Bigyan niyo po kami ng kakayahan na makapagsuri. ng mga ebidensya na may talas ng isipan at wastong pangangatwiran at palagian ng maging patas sa interpretasyon ng mga ito. Panginoon, Lahat po nawa ng aming gagawin ay para sa ikararangal mo, lamang at kapakinabangan ng aming bayan na pinaglilingkuran. Ito po ang aming dalangin ng buong kababaang loob at pagpapasalamat. turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: First and foremost, procedurally, the presentation of retired Justice Amparo Cabotaje-Tang is improper. Your Honor, this is the first time that the Vice President is being confronted with Justice Tang and her testimony. For the record, she is not listed in the pretrial order as witness and there is no reservation for a witness with her designation or background. So, for all intents and purposes, Justice Tang is a surprise witness which violates fair play and is prohibited under the rules. Second, We don't know her personal background and we don't know the extent of her testimony and the documents that she will identify, if any. The prosecution did not even furnish us with copies beforehand and this is already the third time that the prosecution has attempted to present a witness without first furnishing the defense with the materials to be used. Number three, the notice last Wednesday, September 9, 2026, was only to her name, previous official function, and general purpose of her testimony. But upon checking the articles of impeachment, which is the formal charge against the Vice President, her name and testimony were not even alleged therein. Therefore, without the proper link of Justice Tang to this case, and without having been provided in advance with the materials that will be used in her testimony, We could not have possibly predicted what she will testify on. Number 4. In view of the foregoing, it is our position that the presentation of Justice Tang already infringes on the Vice President's right to intelligently cross-examine her, and more importantly, violates the Vice President's constitutional right to due process, particularly her right to be promptly and completely informed of the nature and cause of the accusation against her. Number 5. Substantially, Justice Tang's presentation is likewise improper. She is not testifying as an amicus curiae, a sanction by Section 23, Canon 2 of the Code of Professional Responsibility and Accountability or CIPRA. With all due respect to her, the Court never intervened or gave its approval to her testimony on her expertise or field of specialization. So for this purpose, she is not a friend of the court. Number six, in the Philippines, being a legal expert is not an official designation and is quite subjective. We don't know the extent of her legal knowledge, her political background, whether she's neutral, DDS, loyalista or kakamping, which is hardly distinguishable nowadays, makabayan, or any other affiliation. Number seven, most importantly, by asking for her interpretations on legal principles, she is poised to make conclusions of law that only this honorable impeachment court is allowed to make. What the prosecution cannot do directly under the subjudice rule, it can and will do indirectly through the testimony of this witness.

turns.text: Well, a bar examiner, if chosen by the bar chairperson in the Supreme Court, is asked to submit questions to the bar chairperson. And we check actually the test papers, not the answers, it's now online, of the bar examinees.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Sabi po ninyo, naglingkod kayo bilang bar examiner noong 2015 at 2025. Ano pong subject sa mga bar subjects?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Political law po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Political law. Kasama po ba sa political law yung constitutional law, yung ating 1987 Constitution?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: At yung po bang mga provision ng Constitution, halimbawa tungkol sa public accountability ay kasama po rin po yun, sakop po yun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Move on. Well, balikan ko po ng konti yung inyong paglilingkod nung nasa Office of the Solicitor General po kayo. May experience po ba kayo noong nasa OSG kayo sa mga kasong unexplained or ill-gotten wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. I handled, among other lawyers in the Office of the Solicitor General, the so-called ill-gotten wealth cases.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: In what capacity did you handle those ill-gotten wealth cases, Justice?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: As a solicitor, I handle those cases but when PCGG chairman Sabio took the helm of the PCGG, he created a PCGG-OSG task force where I was designated as the chairperson of the task force.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Bilang chairperson po ng PCGG-OSG task force. Ano-ano po yung ginagawa ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor. May we know the relevance, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Establishing qualifications, if Your Honor is pleased.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Overruled. Witness may answer.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: I reviewed the pleadings of The cases related to those cases.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Estimate lang po, mga ilang oras ang inilaan ninyo sa mga kasong ill-gotten wealth na nabanggit ninyo bilang solicitor at later bilang chairperson ng task force? Estimate lang po.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Probably thousand of hours po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Sunod pong tanong, how about civil forfeiture cases involving money laundering? Nakahawag din po kayo ng ganun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes sir, because the OSG actually is lawyer or acts as a lawyer and files actually these petitions for civil forfeiture with appropriate court.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So nung time po na yun... And that is the situation, isn't it, that the OSJ may hold? Yes. Let's

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: go back to the time when you were the justice and presiding justice of Sandigan Bayan. What is the difference between Sandigan Bayan and other courts? What is unique about it?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, the Sandigan Bayan is a unique court simply because it is both a trial court and appellate court. Pero siyang original jurisdiction and appellate court at the same time. And it is a special court because it tries mostly criminal cases involving high government officials and even private individuals actually who are alleged to have conspired with them in the commission of these crimes.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: More or less lang po, again, just an estimate for the benefit of the court and the public. How many cases more or less did you hear involving the application of Republic Act 3019, the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act, Civil Forfeiture of Unexplained Wealth under Republic Act 1379, and the Code of Conduct of Public Officials and Employees under Republic Act 6713?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: All in all, probably around 700 cases, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: That must have taken you a lot of time po to hear and decide those cases? Mga ilang oras kaya ang inilaan ninyo Para sa pagdinig at pagdesisyon ng mga kasong iyon?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Probably mga thousands of hours din po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Just to, kung susumahin lang po natin, sa loob ng 42 years na kayo ay lingkot bayan, how many hours of that did you spend in terms of studying and analyzing cases of anti-corruption?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Baka mahigit 5,000 hours or more.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, thank you po Justice. I hope, Your Honor, the defense will not object to my next question kahit may pagka maritest po siya. Ito naman po ay para sa mga law student na nangangarap maglingkod bilang maestrado. Nung nasa OSG po kayo, sino po yung mga nakasabay ninyo na later na-appoint sa judiciary?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Marami po. Dalawang nasa Supreme Court ngayon. Yung isang presiding justice ng Court of Appeals, Court of Tax Appeals. Yung nag-retire din ng Court of Tax Appeals presiding justice. At sa Sandigan Bayan, may mga incumbents din po akong mga nakasama nun sa OSG.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: If your honor, please, I have finished questioning the witness on her qualifications. May I proceed to the substance of her testimony?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed, counsel.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, your honor. Okay, panaman po kayo. Please have some water if you need to.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Justice Tang, lagi po natin naririnig yung mga salitang unexplained wealth, hidden wealth, ill-gotten wealth. Para sa mga ordinaryong Pilipino, parang magkapareho lang naman ng mga terms na yan. Sa mata po ng batas, may pagkakaiba po ba yung hidden wealth, unexplained wealth, at ill-gotten wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: May pagkakaiba po sila.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ano po yung pagkakaiba?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, ang hidden wealth. simply means tagong yaman. Ang unexplained wealth naman, this is governed by RA 1379 in relation to RA 3019. Ang ill-gotten wealth naman ay governed by EO numbers 1, 2, 14. Makikita mo rin ito sa transitory provisions of the 1987 Constitution. At yung definition niyan ay matatagpuan rin sa Section 1D ng Republic Act No. 7080 or the Plunder Law as amended.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So kapag binigyan po ang isang lingkod bayan, let's say lang po ha, ng isang bribe, let's say ng 50 million pesos at tinago niya sa pangalan ng ibang tao, hidden wealth po yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Speculative.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Um, what if I counsel?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: May I respond? I know where

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you're getting it.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor. Maari po ba kayo magbigay ng halimbawa ng hidden wealth na sinasabi niyong tagong yaman?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: For example, a public officer owns, actually owns a property but that property is registered in the name of another person.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yun po ang nakatagong yaman? Yes.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Maari po ba kayo magbigay ng isang halimbawa ng unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Unexplained wealth is actually defined in Section 2 of RA 1379.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Babalikan po natin yung puntong yan mamaya-maya. Huling tunang po on this point lang. How about an example for ill-gotten wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ill-gotten wealth according to EO No. 1

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ayun ay mga kayamanan or yaman that was acquired through illegal means like through bribery, misappropriation, malversation, and the like.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, Justice. Ipakita po natin, request lang po sa tech booth, sa screen ang Section 8 ng Republic Act 3019.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Kita po ninyo, Justice, napakahaba niyan tapos puro English na mahirap intindihin. It's very hard even just to read this. Mga bigatin po na salita sa Ingles pa ang ginagamit at nakakaalam mga abugado. Pwede po natin gawin simple ito. Kailan nagiging questionable sa ilalim ng batas ang yaman ng isang opisyal?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ayon sa batas, ito'y questionable if during the incumbency of the public official, he acquired wealth that is grossly disproportionate. To his salary, other lawful income and income generated from his legitimately acquired property.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Tutuong kayamanan dun sa kanyang lehitimong kita. Tama po yun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Paano malalaman ng pamahalaan kung ang isang opisyal ay meron ng unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ito'y karaniwan malalaman kung ang isang opisyal ay nagsumiti ng true and accurate sell-in.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ah, dun pa pala nakikita. Thank you for that justice. Ano-ano mga bagay naman ang dapat tingnan? ng mga nag-iimbestiga ng unexplained wealth maliban po sa SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yung lifestyle, IT, yung income tax returns.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: How about the records, for example, pertaining to the financial status of that person? Objection, leading. Can you modify, counsel? If you're honest, please, the question is not leading, it's how about. I'm asking the witness. But anyway, I will replace. Can you modify, counsel? Yes, thank you. Nabanggit po ninyo kanina na tinitingnan po ninyo yung SAL-N, tinitingnan po ninyo yung ITR. What other records, if any, does an investigator look at when it comes to unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Even the properties and assets of the spouse and the children under 18 years of age.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, sorry to interrupt. Yes, Attorney Mark. Just a query, Your Honor. Actually, this is the danger that we were concerned about because I don't think the prosecution qualified this witness as an expert witness. Therefore, whatever opinion that she will share with us today is not expert opinion but just her personal opinion. And that is the danger of presenting her because she might present her own interpretations of the law, again, which is the function of this court, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: So we're objecting to this line of questions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Again, counsel, whatever she says is subject to cross her representation of another witness. Besides, anything she says, as the court said, as the presiding officer said earlier, is neither conclusive nor binding upon this court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, we will note the objection. The objection is overruled and you have a continuing objection with respect to this witness's qualification anyway. Attorney, rather Honorable Chell, you may proceed.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Ipakita po natin sa screen ang bahagi ng Section 8 na nakahighlight. Ayan po. Focus po muna tayo dun sa unang bahagi ng Section 8. Kasi medyo mahirap lunokin yung buong provision po na yan at napakahaba. I'll just read it if I may. Quote, If in accordance with the provisions of Republic Act 1379, a public official has been found to have acquired during his incumbency, whether in his name or in the name of other persons, an amount of property and or money manifestly out of proportion to his salary, and to his other lawful income, that fact shall be a ground for dismissal or removal. I'd like to emphasis the last part, yung pong nakalagay na that fact shall be a ground for dismissal or removal. Ano pong ibig sabihin ito?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ang ibig niyang sabihin ay if a public officer is found to have acquired unexplained wealth, In accordance with Republic Act 1379, that is a ground for removal or dismissal.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Sa madaling salita po, pagka napatunayan nga yung mga kinakailangan ng batas para sa masabi na merong unexplained wealth, ito ay maaaring nang tanggalin ang opisyal na iyon.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Balikan po natin ang Section 8 ng... RA 3019. Babalikan po natin mamaya yung Section 8. Punta po muna tayo sa Section 2 ng RA1379. Ayan po yung nasa screen po ngayon. Nakalagay naman dito, quote, Whenever any public officer or employee has acquired during his incumbency an amount of property which is manifestly out of proportion to his salary, a such public officer or employee, and to his other lawful income and the income from legitimately acquired property, said property shall be presumed prima facie to have been unlawfully acquired Palagay ko po yung salitang presumed prima facie ay medyo mahirap intindihin. Sa simpleng salita, maaari po ba ninyong ipaliwanag po yun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ang ibig sabihin po ng prima facie, actually prima facie is a Latin word. It means, literally in English, on the face of it or on its face. So ang ibig sabihin yan, kapag napakita ng isang opisyal ay nag-acquire ng property that is grossly or manifestly disproportionate to his salary, lawful income, and income from lawfully acquired properties, ito ay ipinapalagay na unlawfully acquired.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ilinawin po natin, kapag may ganitong presumption, ibig bang sabihin ay guilty na agad ang opisyal?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ay hindi po. Itong presumption na ito ay rebuttable. Ibig sabihin kapag magkapag... Presenta ng ebidensya naman or maipaliwanag satisfactorily ng empleyado or opisyal that he acquired those properties lawfully, mawawala po yung visa ng presumption na yan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you so much, Justice. In other words, Justice, kung hindi tugma ang yaman ng isang opisyal sa kanyang legal na kita, pwedeng itanong na ng batas saan ang galing ang pera?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: At siyempre, may obligasyon po ba? I will withdraw and ask another question. At may obligasyon po ba ang pamahalaan na imbestigahan nito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Rejection leading, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I will rephrase. What obligation does the government have in that situation?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, Section 8 of RA 1379 mandates that a preliminary inquiry be conducted.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Move on na po tayo, Justice, sa pangalawang paksa.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Justice, paano naman kung sabihin ng isang opisyal, eh hindi naman sa akin nakapangalan niyang property. Tapos na po ba agad ang

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: usapan? Objection speculative, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Candidate Forum Counsel, again, you know how to get there.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Justice Tang, what is the state of the law when it comes to property that is in the name of a person other than the government official concerned?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, under Section 8 of Republic Act 3019, the properties in the name of other persons and even the spouse and the children may be considered in determining whether the official has unlawfully accord. Properties.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Bakit po? Bakit pati ang ari-arian ng asawa at ng ibang tao ay maaari din tingnan sa ilalim ng batas?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection already calls for an opinion, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: He qualified, he tried to at least qualify the witness as an expert counsel. Again, for as long as it is general and does not apply specifically to this case, we will allow it. Your

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Honor, can we just make a clarification? Was she qualified as a legal expert by the court? No, the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: court need not declare a witness to be an expert, counsel. Again, as the court said earlier, subject to cross and subject to using the factors in the Frye and Dobert case. You may question this witness's credibility, reliability, and expertise, if any. Again, whatever she says will not be binding nor conclusive upon the court anyway.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: We'll submit your

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: order. Honorable Chal, you may proceed.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Sir,

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: can you please repeat the question?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Bakit po pagdating po sa bagay ng unexplained wealth ay pati yung mga ari-arian ng asawa o mga nakapangalan sa ibang tao ay maaari din tingnan?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, according to the Supreme Court, actually in the case of Republic v. Rabusa and Rabusa v. Republic, this is to prevent concealment. and to obviate the circumstance that a public official is able to evade investigation.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, Justice. Ipakita po natin yung Section 8 ng Republic Act 3019 na nakahighlight po yung susunod na slide, please. Next slide, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Meron pong nakahighlight dyan sa bandang gitna ng Section 8. Pabasahin ko lang po yung bahagi na iyon. Bank deposits in the name of the public official, his spouse or any of their dependents shall likewise be taken into consideration in the enforcement of this section, notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary. Paliwanag na po ninyo yung maaring natingnan ng properties ng asawa o mga dependent. Pero ano po yung nakalagay doon sa dulo? Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ang ibig sabihin po yan ay kahit may nagbabawal na batas na gawin yun.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Move on na po tayo sa pangatlong paksa.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Justice, punta naman tayo sa presidente at vicepresidente. Pareho lang po ba ang rules? Sa kanila at sa ordinaryong government employee pagdating sa kanilang kita at financial interests?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Objection leading, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: May I respond if Your Honor is pleased? Yes, Honorable Shell. Can I respond? I am simply asking if the rules are the same. But if the court would like, I can rephrase the question to make it non-leading.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kindly rephrase, counsel, but in the interest of time as well.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: What are the rules, Justice, insofar as a President and Vice President are concerned as compared to the ordinary government employee.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: There are stricter prohibitions on the President and Vice President and even actually the Cabinet Secretaries. They're under secretaries and assistants.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Bakit po mas mahigpit ang batas pagdating sa Presidente, Vice Presidente at Cabinet members?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, ayon sa Korte Suprema in the case of Civil Liberties Union, versus Executive Secretary.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: There is the greater possibility of abuse in their office given their positions.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, please. If I may be allowed to make a manifestation. Your Honor, we understand the position of this court that the testimony of the witness is not binding upon this court. But how about the general public?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: This already serves as conditioning of the mind of the public. After all, the public is not educated as to which of these laws that the witness is testifying on is applicable to this case or not. And we just want to make that for the record.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: To the facts surrounding this case and this case in particular against the respondent. But the prosecution wishes to use up one of their 15 witnesses and one of their trial dates on the Honorable Justice Tang. And the court allowed it, counsel. So you may proceed, Honorable Jackdo.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Ipakita po natin ang Article 7, Section 6 ng ating Constitution, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Meron pong nakasulat po sa bandang dulo nitong provision. First, in the beginning part of this provision, it says, the salaries of the President and Vice President shall be determined by law. And then at the end, it says, they shall not receive during their tenure any other emolument from the government or any other source. Ano pong ibig sabihin ito?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Simply, ang ibig sabihin niyan, hindi pwedeng tumanggap yung presidente o vicepresidente ng sahod mula sa kanilang legitimate na sahod at sa iba pang sources.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Eh kami pong mga mambabatas ay wala naman pong ganun na restriction. Bakit po ganitong kahigpit ang konstitusyon natin pagdating sa pangulo at pangalawang pangulo?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, it's the same reason I gave in the case of, cited by the Supreme Court in the case of Civil Society versus Executive Secretary.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you po. Move on na po tayo sa pang-apat na paksa.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Habang po ay presidente o vice-presidente ang isang tawag...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: With the permission of the Honorable Jocno, Justice Tang, you interpreted emolument to mean salary? If I heard you correctly?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay. Thank

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: you.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: If I may proceed, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: If

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I may proceed, Your Honor, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Question po, Justice. Habang presidente o vicepresidente, pwede po ba silang basta sumali o makilahok sa negosyo?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Saan pong batas nakalagay ang pagbabawal na ito?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: I think it's Section 13 of Article 7 of the Constitution.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ipakita po natin ang Section 13. Yes.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Madali lang po naman naiintindihin yung ibang salita dyan. They cannot directly participate in business. Pero ano po kaya ang ibig sabihin ng indirectly na mag-participate na bawal daw?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Indirectly simply means hindi silang gumagawa pero iba ang gumagawa but in their name. So ibang tao ang gumagawa para sa kanila.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Sa ganun sitwasyon, sino pong nakikinabang?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yung official.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Dito po ba pumapasok yung salitang beneficial owner?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Siyempre po maraming mga kababayan natin ay hindi po pamilyarang sa salitang beneficial owner. Pakipaliwanag po.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ang beneficial owner ay yung tunay na taong nagmamayari ng ari-arian. or sa interest sa korporasyon. Although, based on legal documents, ibang taong nakapangalan doon.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you so much, Justice. One more question on this point. So, ibig sabihin, posibleng magkaiba ang pangalan na nasa papel at ang taong tunay na nakikinabang o may financial interest?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Move on na po tayo sa panglimang paksa.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Justice, may isa pang sinasabi ang ating konstitusyon na pwede pong ipakita ang Article 7, Section 13.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Nakalagay po dyan na bawal ang presidente at vicepresidente magkaroon ng financial interest sa kontrata, franchise, o special privilege mula sa gobyerno. Bakit po ganon?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Again, the ruling of the Supreme Court in the case of a civil

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Liberties po.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Liberties versus executive secretary.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Maari po ba kayong magbigay ng halimbawa ng may financial interest sa kontrata ang isang presidente o vice-presidente?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, I will cite a case involving a Supreme Court case. The president entering into a contract of lease with a government agency.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So pagka ang Pangulo po ay nagkaroon ng kontrata kahit sabihin natin lease contract lahang po ay maaari po yan na maging paglabag sa having financial interest in a contract with the government.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes sir.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Meron pong nakalagay din sa bandang dulo nitong Section 13. They, this is referring to the President, Vice President and Cabinet members, quote, shall strictly avoid conflict of interest in the conduct of their office. Medyo mabigat pong salita yung conflict. Conflict

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: of interest. Ano pong ibig sabihin nun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Conflict of interest simply means na yung interest ng opisyal, pribadong interest ng opisyal na yun ay salungat sa interest ng pamahalaan ng kanyang pinagsisilbihan.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Salamat po. Move on na po tayo sa pinakahuling topic. Justice, napagusapan na natin yung legal nakita, napagusapan natin yung mga properties, negosyo, financial interest. Bilang public official, saan dapat i-deklara ang assets, liabilities, at net worth ng isang opisyal?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Sa kanyang SAL-N po. Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth, Financial Interest, at saka Business Interest.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Para sa ordinaryong Pilipino po, bakit pa natin pinasa-SAL-N ang mga opisyal ng gobyerno?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ito ay nire-require hindi lang ng Constitution at iba pa nating ibang imuiral na batas para malaman kung ang isang opisyal ba ay umaman habang siya ay nasa pwesto at kung papaano niya na-acquire itong yaman na ito.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ipakita po natin ang first page ng sale and form please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Para lang po ba itong form na basta-basta lang sinasubmit ng opisyal o may mas mahalagang layunin ito laban sa corruption?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, hindi lang ito basta-basta na form po. Ito ay kailangan isumite. And according to the Supreme Court, it must be true, correct, and proper form.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I-close up po natin yung gitnang bahagi po ng page 1 ng SAL-N, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Kung may asawa po ang public official, ano naman po ang kailangan i-disclose tungkol sa assets, liabilities? Business interests and financial connections ng kanyang asawa ayon sa batas.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ayon sa batas kailangan din isama yung mga ari-arian ng asawa. But let me just qualify sir. Because in the case of Abid Babano versus the Executive Secretary, ang sabi ng Korte Suprema, if the spouses had a complete separation of property, or sa property relations nila before the marriage, then the spouse of that official, the property of the spouse of the official need not be included in that official's SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: So, ibig sabihin po kapag meron yung tinatawag na prenuptial agreement ang magiging mag-asawa o kaya habang sila yung nag-asawa na ay nag-judicial separation of properties, hindi na po kailangan i-disclose sa SAL-N yung mga assets, liabilities, at net worth ng asawa.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Yan po ang turo ng Supreme Court.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Ipakita po natin yung notarial acknowledgement po ng SAL-N form, please.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Justice, may isang bagay po na gusto ko lang itanong tungkol dito. Ang SAL-N po ba ay pinipirmahan under oath?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Opo, it's required under the law.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: At pakiclose up po yung notarial portion po ng SAL-N. E ano po ang ibig sabihin kapag ang isang dokumento tulad ng SAL-N ay pinirmahan na may pagpapanumpa?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well... Once a document is notarized, it becomes a public document. And everything that is stated there is attested to as truthful or true by the one who executes the document.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Thank you. Malapit na po akong matapos. Ipakita po natin ang susunod po na slide.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Sabi po ng Supreme Court sa isang desisyon, Office of the Ombudsman versus Valencia. And I will just quote that portion. A public officer in the discharge of duties is to use that prudence, caution, and attention which careful persons use in the management of his affairs. First question po, kasi medyo mabigat po itong mga salita. Ano pong ibig sabihin yan?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Dapat pag nag-submit ang isang official ng kanyang SAL-N, dapat ito ay tama at wasto?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Ibig sabihin po, dapat maging maingat at prudente ang mga opisyal na ng ating gobyerno sa pag-fill up po at pag-execute ng SAL-N. Objection leading, Your Honor. I'll just move on if you're honest, please. Kindly move on, Counsel. Thank you. Huling slide na po, pakishow lang sa screen. In the same case, the Supreme Court said, and I quote, By the SAL-N, the public are able to monitor movement in the fortune of a public official. It is a valid check and balance mechanism to verify undisclosed properties and wealth. Ano pong masasabi niyo tungkol dyan sa pinasa ko?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ang ibig sabihin niyan ay ang SAL-N ay isang notoryadong dokumento and it is also an accountability framework para

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: accountability framework. Kaya pag nag-execute ang isang official, dapat he should do it by exercising prudence, caution, and attention doon sa details na nakasaad doon sa kanyang statement of assets and liabilities.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I have no more questions. If Your Honor, please, I would just like to thank the good justice for her appearance today.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Will you cross today, Attorney Mark? Or do we proceed with the interjection of Senator-Judges?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mark C. Vinluan
turns.text: Your Honor, can we ask if we can be allowed to conduct our cross-examination after lunch?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: After lunch. After lunch it shall be. So we shall proceed with the interjections of Senator-Judges. Do we have a list, Anika?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Your Honor, may I be allowed to take my seat? Yes,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: of course, Attorney Chel. The Honorable Chel.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Chel, forgive me if I confuse you. If I call you attorney sometimes, given that you're a member of Congress. May I get the list, Annika, please?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Okay,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: this is from Annika, not from me, okay? So if I didn't see your hands, it's not my fault. The Honorable Senator-Judge Rafi Tulfo is recognized for his interjection.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may proceed when you're ready, sir. You have two minutes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Madam Witness, yung bang labas-pasok na pera sa account ng isang public official at hindi po yan na-deklara sa SAL-N, ano po ang tawag doon?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, depende po yan kasi the SAL-N is required to be submitted every April 30 of the year. So, ang mag-govern dyan is magkano yung pera mo doon sa bank account mo at as of that time.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Halimbawa po umabot sa bilyones yung pasok-labas ng pera from a certain account ng isang public official, umabot na po ng bilyones and yet pag ibalance mo, bilyon pa rin po ang halaga total but it wasn't declared at sabihin na ayan ay pinark lang or ayan ay dumaan lang sa account ko at hindi ko naman talaga pera yan. How would you qualify that?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, still kap, basta nasa pangalan niya yung, nasa account name niya. o yung pangalan niya ang nandun sa account, that must still be declared in the SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: So kung hindi po na-declare sa SAL-N, ano pong tawag doon?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, it's an omission.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Omission. So would that be considered as unexplained wealth, hidden wealth, questionable wealth? Huwag po kayong gumamit ng RE. Kung gagamit kayo ng RE, pakidefine lang para maintindihan po yung taong bayan.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Hindi naman nangangahulugan na pag may omission doon sa SAL-N e kaagad sasabihin na there is unexplained wealth. Kasi according to the Supreme Court nga doon sa kaso ni Carlos versus Executive Secretary, dapat mabigyan ng pagkakataon iyong public officer na ipaliwanag bakit hindi na isama sa kanyang SAL-N iyong mga ibang assets na hindi naka-include doon sa kanyang SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Pero kung perennial, palagi po nangyayari na lang, year after year, yung ganong klaseng omission na sinasabi niyo, so how would you consider that?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, according to the Supreme Court, dapat titignan mo kung yung omission na yan is an honest omission or it was an honest mistake vis-a-vis or compared to an intentional concealment. Pero that will already depend on the attending facts. Depende po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Halimbawa po, Maraming property ang isang public official at sabi nyo nga kanina kapag hindi dideklara that's unexplained wealth. Pero ang sasabihin naman ng isang public official eh yan naman ay sa aking husband at ang husband ko ay kumikita naman dahil siya ay merong magandang profesyon pero hindi na nadeclare ng husband although wala silang prenuptial agreement. How would you consider that?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Under RA 1379, binibigyan naman ng pagkakataon yung official na mag-explica o magpaliwanag. Kung katanggap-tanggap naman yung kanyang eksplanasyon na lawfully acquired yung properties na iyon, it will not be considered as unexplained wealth.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Lawfully acquired yung property na iyon pero it was not declared doon sa SAL-N. May problema ba doon o wala po, Madam Witness?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, according to the Supreme Court, again in the case of Carlos versus Executive Secretary, titignan maigi kung meron bang intentional omission yan or wala. O kaya intentional concealment that amounts to fraud.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. You did mention about concealment. So, kailan po masasabi na intentional concealment versus omission yung isang declaration o hindi diniklara o diniklara sa SAL-N na kinita niya ng taong iyon?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: May mga kaso na decided ang Supreme Court. I just can't remember one of those, the title of those cases now na kung repeated. repeated yung omission that can already demonstrate intentional concealment. Kaya pwedeng maging ground, pwedeng, it can constitute dishonesty.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Maraming salamat po, Madam Witness. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you, Senator-Judge Rafi Tulfo. Next, first interjection. Court recognizes Senator-Judge Villanueva. You have two minutes, sir. You may proceed when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer. Ma'am, good morning.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Doon po sa binanggit niyo na pwedeng i-correct ang isang SALN, tingnan po natin yung good faith error versus doon po sa deliberate concealment of wealth. Sa paglalapat po ng prinsipyong ito, Madam Witness, ano pong kongkretong ibidensya ang dapat po nating timbangin? sa inyo pong karanasan para po ma-distinguish talaga itong dalawa na ito and how significant are the officials sa explanation, supporting documents, response to the review and the compliance process ma'am?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, katulad ng nabanggit ko kanina sir, kapag repeated yan like for five consecutive years Hindi na include yung property niyan. This is a badge na there is an attempt at concealment.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Pag-repeated. Yes.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: when you say repeated, ma'am, at least ang repeated, dalawa lang ho yan eh. Pero kung lima, tatlong repeated na ho yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Tama po ba, ma'am? Tama po. And what should be provided to determine po whether or not the correction was made in good faith? or whether the original omission involved deliberate concealment.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, mayroong isang Supreme Court case actually na in 2002 or 2002 and 2003 na i-declare nung official yung kanya doon sa yung asset na yun sa SAL-N niya but those assets were excluded or not included in his subsequent SAL-Ns. So he was questioned but The Supreme Court said that the Supreme Court found that honest mistake lang yung kanyang nagawa.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Ma'am, paano niyo po ihiwalay yung dati na niyang pag-aari? For instance, napundar niya habang nasa pwesto po siya. Paano niyo isasaalang-alang kung kailan at... At magkano binili ang mga ito, ang mga utang at ang pagbabago sa halagang nakasaad po sa kanyang sale. Halimbawa po ma'am, kunyari nagbenta po siya ng lupa at ginamit niya yung parehong salapi para bumili ng bahay. How can the court avoid counting the same funds twice when an asset is sold and the proceeds are reinvested?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Dapat hindi na niya po yung i-include yung naibenta niya, kundi just the proceeds ng kanyang pagbebenta.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Yung proceeds lang po? Yes. Ma'am, isa pang katanungan. Pinapayagan po ng rules ang pag-grupo ng ilang personal properties. Pero sapat na po bang kasama ang cash sa total ng... Other assets. Madalas ito kasi parang nai-encounter. Kung hindi po malinaw kung magkano ang cash at kung ano ang iba pang ari-arian, kailan po sapat, Madam Witness, ang pag-grupo at kailan naman po kailangan ng hiwalay na detalye?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: RA 6713, yung cash on hand and cash in bank, they must be specifically declared in the SALN. Hindi pwede i-lump yun sa ibang other personal properties.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: So would you say, ma'am, last na po, Mr. Presiding Officer, would you say that this is not a usual practice? Unusual po na inilalump yung cash dun sa other assets?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: I will not consider it unusual, but it is against the provision of Section 8 of RA 6713. And

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: therefore, if you do that, you are violating the law itself. That's your... Yes

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: sir, pero... Again, doon kasi po sa kaso ni Carlos versus Executive Secretary, meron po tayong tinatawag ng Review and Compliance Procedure under Section 10 of 6713 na binibigyan ng pagkakataon actually yung public official para ayusin kung merong it was not timely filed, it is not in proper form, at saka I just forgot, yung isa pang tatlo po yung kailangan na doon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Joel Villanueva
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Justice. Thank you. Thank you. Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you, Senator Judge Villanueva. Our Senate President, Senator Wayne Gachalian is recognized for his interjections. You have two minutes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Good

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: morning, Madam Justice.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Unexplained wealth po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Sa aking palagay, Hindi naman po yan linalagay sa SAL-N. Typically, hindi nila dinideclare yan kasi unexplained wealth. So, in your opinion, anong mga dokumento ang dapat tignan para po makita at ma-detect po itong unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Katulad ng kaso sa Heirs of Ligot versus Sandiganbayan, pati na rin yung sa Rabusa versus Republics. Tinitignan din yung mga assets ng asawa tsaka ng mga anak and even other persons for as long as, according to the case of Ligot versus Sandiganbayan, the acquisition is traceable to the public official.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Can you cite an example? Paano po matitrace to a public official?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Ang determinant po dyan, ang nagdedetermine yan according to the Supreme Court is, ito bang mga taong ito, yung asawa-anak o yung ibang tao, were they financially capable to lawfully acquire those assets? Kung wala silang kapasidad na bilhin yun in their independent capacity, then that will be traceable yung acquisition na yun doon sa public official. Then that asset will be attributed as asset of the public official.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Based on your experience, Madam Justice, paano po tinatago ang unexplained wealth? Based on your experience, ano po yung mga nakikita niyong ways para itagoy ng unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, yung public official will employ dummies or nominees or even proxies po. Or the assets are registered in the name of or names of other people.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: How about po yung pag-cash naman po? We're talking about assets.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Pag cash naman, for example, ayaw niya bumili ng assets but cash, paano pa-detect yung mga ganitong unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, kung nasa possession niya yung without depositing it in a bank, mahirap po yun, mahirap yun makita. But if these are deposits in banks and registered in the names of other persons but the ownership

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: How

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: about yung time horizon, Madam Justice? Kailangan gaano kahaba ba yung time horizon na dapat tignan in the accumulation of unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Wala namang tinitignan na period po yan. Depende na po yun sa investigation that will be conducted.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: How about yung unexplained wealth? Pag let's say meron nga nakitang unexplained wealth, sino po ang dapat mag-prove nitong unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, katulad ng nasabi ko po kanina, there are three requisites na sinabi ng Supreme Court. para mag-arise itong prima facie presumption of unexplained wealth. Sinabi ng Supreme Court sa kaso ni Heirs of Ligot v. Sandiganbayan, number one, that the respondent is a public officer. Number two, that during his incumbency, he has acquired property that is manifestly disproportionate to his lawful income.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Assuming yung respondent, dapat ba i-prove niya na this is not unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes po. Because this time, because of this prima facie presumption na unlawfully acquired yung property, the burden of proof now shifts to the official to show that he has legitimately acquired those properties alleged to have. alleged to be unlawfully acquired.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Assuming those are not declared in the SALN, paano niya i-defend o paano niya i-justify yung wealth accumulation?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, if he can present evidence that he was able to acquire these assets, Lawfully, like from lawful gratuitous gifts

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: or donate gifts. Pwede pa rin yun po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Even in the absence of a declaration in the SAL-N, hindi niya din-declare.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Hindi niya din-declare sa SAL-N niya pero yun ang ginamit niyang defense for his Unexplained wealth. Is that acceptable? Can that be accepted?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So kailangan ho magtugma sa SAL-N and also the explanation?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. In

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: other words?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: And pag hindi ho nagtugma, is that grounds for removal or removal from office?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, according to Section 8

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: of RA No. 3019,

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Kapag napatunayan nga na may unexplained wealth yung tao, yung opisyal, ayon sa pamantayan ng RA 1379, that will serve as a ground for removal or dismissal.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: This will be quick, Mr. Presiding Officer. Madam Witness, Retired Justice, Paano po pag yung isang opisyal nag-deposit ng 20, 30, o 50 million sa account niya, pero after a few days winidraw niya naman ho? Is that considered ill-gotten or unexplained? Eh winidraw niya naman ho kaagad. Kailangan ba siyang tanungin? Oy, bakit may pera kang ganun? Eh, binidraw niya naman agad. Di naman tumagal sa account. At wala lang. Parang naglaho, parang bula. How's that?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, siguro ambla nang mag-ano dyan po. Kasi may mga requirements dyan sa Anti-Money Laundering Act regarding itong mga ganitong mga deposits na ito.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Paano ko sabihin mo niya, Madam Witness? Hindi naman sa akin yan eh. Hinawakan ko lang para sa iba. For example, sabihin niya sa asawa niya or sa kamag-anak niya, dumaan lang doon, pinahawak lang sa kanya. Pero wala naman, pag three days natin, wala naman talaga, hindi natin makikita doon. Paano naman daw huyo? Kailangan pa ba siyang imbestigahan? Eh sandali lang, three days o one week lang huyong pera doon sa account niya.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, I will be answering po the question based on

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: 1379. Kung dapat yun dineklara niya sa SAL-N niya at the time na nasa kanya pa. Kung baga, when he filed his SAL-N na nanood pa sa kanyang pangalan yung deposito na yun, ay dapat in-include niya yun sa kanyang assets.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: So, pero kung within that year, for example, 2026, for example, last month, Pero after few days, winidraw niya kaagad. Winidraw ng opisyal. And wala nang trace. So, ka-questionin pa ba siya? Kailangan pa ba siyang questionin?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, that will be a different matter. It will not be included in his salin kasi kung at the time he's required to file his salin, wala na yun sa deposito niya sa bangko. But that can be the subject probably of an inquiry by the Anti-Money Laundering Council.

turns.speaker: Sen. Erwin Tulfo
turns.text: Thank you Madam Witness. Thank you Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: The Chair will have- Senator Judge Sotto is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: may proceed sir. You have two minutes when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Thank you Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Out of curiosity, I did not hear it well earlier. There was a mention of your ruling. Sandigan Bayan ruling that was overturned by the Supreme Court. Arroyo, something as mentioned. Ano po yung ruling nyo na overturned?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Your Honor, hindi po akong, I was not part of the division that rendered that decision.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: It

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: was another decision.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: had no

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: participation in the denial of the demurrer to evidence. Probably, may I continue? Probably, yung sinasabi kanina ng counsel, it has something to do with one of my speeches that I delivered before the UP College of Law. At saka dito sa Dalawang events po yun na sabi ko, perhaps there is a need to re-examine yung ruling na ito kasi nga po, sa tingin ko lang, prosecuting plunder has become more difficult for the prosecution because in that case, nire-require kasi po ng Supreme Court yung allegation of a mastermind. Kaya sabi ko, maybe it's time that Congress re-examine this law para to help in the prosecution of these cases. For as long as the allegation of conspiracy is there, is alleged there in the information, there may be no need anymore to identify the main plunderer in the case or in a case for plunder. Yun lang po ang sinabi ko. Wala na po akong sinabi. But I was not part of the division that rendered the resolution denying the demurrer to evidence of former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Mabanggit ko lang din para mapaalala natin pagdating doon sa mga SAL-N.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Sapagkat yung SAL-N, hindi alam ng karamihan, lalo na siguro ng mga kababayan natin, na kaming mga public officials ay mayroong pinirmahan doon sa SAL-N. Nandoon sa last paragraph ng bago ka pumirma na nag-aattest ka na totoo lahat yung sinasabi mo. Doon sa sale na iyon, nakalagay po doon na we are authorizing, oh no, the ombudsman is authorized. Waiver po yung pinirma namin ng ombudsman may look into or may authorize any agency to inspect or to investigate us. Pati mga bank accounts at lahat yan. Kaya nga po meron ganon. Kaya yung nababanggit kanina ni Senator Erwin na kung sabihin niya, eh hindi akin yung pera eh. Hindi naman akin, pinakahawa ka lang, nilagay lang sa akin. Ngayon, dapat mag-submit ka ng SAL-IN. Baka ilagay mo yun o hindi?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Kung nasa possession mo pa rin po yung pera, you have to declare it.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Nung nagpa-file ka ng SAL-N? Yes, sir. Kahit hindi iyo yun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Tama. Alright. Thank you. Senator-Judge

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Lacson for his first round and then Senator-Judge Rafi Tulfo for his second.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You may

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: proceed,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator-Judge Lacson.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Good morning po, Justice.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Good morning, sir. Sa

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: akin lang po, bakit po ba limitado lamang sa Pangulo? At sa pangalawang pangulo, ang paglahok sa anumang uri ng negosyo. Bakit hindi po ito nag-a-apply indirectly or indirectly ang sinasabi? At hindi ito nag-a-apply sa gobernador, sa mayor, mga senador, at congressmen.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Katulad sir po na nabanggit ko kanina dun sa Supreme Court case, nakalimutan ko na naman yung title, na given the fact that the president and vice president are the two highest officials of the land, ay sinasabi dun, there is the greater possibility of abuse in their office.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Hindi po ba mag-a-apply din sa gobernador? At least within his area of jurisdiction?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, mayroon sa Republic Act 6713 yung mga prohibitions din po regarding local government officials and the other officials in government.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Pero qualified po yung talagang Pangulo at Pangalawang Pangulo. Ano mang uri ng negosyo, directly or indirectly, hindi talaga sila, maski nga yung kanilang mga spouses, eh hindi talaga pwede lumahok. Absolute po eh. Samantal, yung tanong ko po, bakit hindi nag-apply o nag-a-apply sa ibang opisyalis o executive opisyalis ng gobyerno na similarly situated, although Alam ko po na yung pangulo at saka pangalawang pangulo, malawak buong Pilipinas. Pero hindi po ba in a similar vein, same vein, kung sa loob ng isang probinsya, ang pinaka-chief executive naman doon ay gobernador. At sa isang bayan o isang siyudad, ang chief executive doon ay yung mayor. Ano lang po ito, hindi naman po ito out, sabi nga ni Senate President Sotto. Out of curiosity, bakit po ganun na application?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Kasi nga, they have greater powers, sabi ng Supreme Court, kaya yung more stringent ang prohibition sa kanila. And because of the powers that they wield, there is the greater possibility of abuse in their office.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo M. Lacson
turns.text: Maraming salamat po. Thank you, Mr.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator-Judge, Rafi is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Salampung katalungan ko, Madam. Witness, and Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Sa Sandigan, 12 years po kayo, no?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Okay. Doon sa 12 years na experience, I'm sure meron kayo nahawakan ng mga kaso na kung saan nasampa ng kaso ang isang government officials dahil yung kanyang income hindi bumabanga doon sa kanyang salin o doon sa mga pera niya sa bangko. So, meaning merong undeclared or unquestionable wealth or hidden wealth, etc. Ano nangyari dun sa mga kasong iyon? Ano nangyari dun sa mga government official na iyon na dumaan sa paglilitis ninyo?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: As far as I can recall, in one case, I will not mention the name of the government official involved. We actually forfeited or declared forfeited yung mga assets na prove. na they were unlawfully or illegally acquired.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Ano nangyayari naman dun sa tao? Siya ba ay nasibak sa servisyo? Nakulong?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: At that time, wala na po siya

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: sa

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: pwesto.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Pero wala pa kinahawakan kung saan yung isang government official tulad ng nabanggit kanina na senaryo na siya ay nasibak sa servisyo o nakulong?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Wala pa po. Unfortunately, yung isa na kaso, namatay yung government official.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Pero kung hindi siya namatay, anong sana nangyari?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: I will not speculate, sir. Thank you, Mr. President.

turns.speaker: Sen. Raffy T. Tulfo
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: you, Senator Judge Rafi. Senator Judge Kiko Pangilinan, you may proceed, sir, with your interjection. Thank you. Actually,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: isang question lang. Siguro may isang follow-up kung kailangan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: Marami kasi ang ating mga kababayan nakikinig, nanonood. Ngayong ill-gotten wealth ang pinag-uusapan. Yung ill-gotten wealth ba kinakailangan pondo ng gobyerno?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Not necessarily po kasi if you look at the plunder law, there are five overt or criminal acts kung tawagin na if committed through a series or combination at ang na-amass or na-acquire or na-amass na wealth is at the threshold, the minimum threshold of 50 million pesos can still constitute plunder.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: And the 50 million need not be public funds?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: No sir, because I think it's paragraph B about bribery. Bribery, the money generally does not come from government but from other persons.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis Pangilinan
turns.text: Okay. Yun lang. Maraming salamat Justice.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Thank you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Before we break for lunch. Just some interjections from the chair. Ma'am, Justice Tang, you said because of the provision on prima facie in 1379, Section 2, the burden of proof shifts? I think you meant the burden of evidence shifts.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: It's burden of proof, sir, according to the Supreme Court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: In Ligot? I didn't see that in Ligot, ma'am. In Ligot, it didn't say that exactly. So the burden, it's your position that the burden of proof and not the burden of evidence shifts?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. I read that in one case, but I just don't remember the Supreme Court case now.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And the basis, if at all, would be Section 2 of 1379?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I will respect your opinion, ma'am. I may disagree, but I will respect your opinion. Next. You said upon being asked kung ano yung asset niya at the time of filing. Isn't it asset nung official as of December 31, not at the time of filing? Because filing is on April 30, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. I stand correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, as of December 31. Yes, sir. In theory, ma'am, kung may pumasok na pera at lumabas ng October, pumasok at lumabas ng November, pero pagdating ng December 31, wala yun sa account mo. Obligado ka bang i-declare po yun, in your opinion, sa iyong April 30 filing ng SALN?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: No more, sir, kasi wala na yung asset na yun or pondo at as of December 31 of that year.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: At doon na po papasok yung binanggit niyong AMLAC? Yes,

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, ma'am. A few more questions, ma'am. You cited Section 6, rather, Article 7 from any source. I asked earlier, you only meant emolument. You didn't meant salary. You didn't meant any other income.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Not salary, sir. It's income.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Kita. So,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: emolument, you mean, is not limited to salary?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Shall not receive any emolument. That is salary, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, salary, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, let's say may shares of stock. Yung tumakbong presidente, nanalo. Nag-declare ng dividendo yung kumpanya. That's not salary. Is that legal or illegal in your opinion?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: No, it's not. It's not illegal.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, he or she can take it? Pwede yan?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kasi hindi siya salary.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Next, ma'am. Article 7, Section 13 makes mention of the word, participate in any business. My question is, ba't hindi sinabi sa Saligang Batas, have an interest in any business? Bakit participate? Kasi nakalagay sa bandang huling ng provision ng Section 13, conflict of interest. Ito hindi sinasabing conflict of interest. Binanggit lang yung conflict of interest in relation to a contract with government or a financial interest with any license or franchise issued by government. Pero nilagay po sa business, participate in business. Ano po ibig sabihin? Hindi siya pwedeng magmay-ari ng negosyo o hindi siya pwedeng makilahok sa negosyong pag-ari niya. Meaning actively run it.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Your Honor, ang participate naman nakalagay dyan directly or indirectly.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Meaning?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Meaning, whether ownership in a corporation or participating either as a director or as an officer of the corporation, that is prohibited.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ma'am, it is in line, directly or indirectly is in line with the practice of any other profession, participate in any business. Hindi ba parang ibig sabihin ito? Kapag ka pangulo kay kalawang pangulo, huwag mong pagkaabalahan ano pang ibang bagay. Ito ang pangunahin mong trabaho. Ito lang ang dapat mong tutukan. Yes, sir. Does it also include not owning a business?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, it is your position that a president and or vice president should divest from any businesses that they may have after they take their oath?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. In fact, there is... Under the law, there is a need to divest upon assumption of office immediately and within 30 days.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: What law would that be, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: I think it's 6713, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: It's in the Code of Ethical Standards?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: I see that being done by most secretaries whenever they're appointed, whenever they have a business that's related to the department they will be heading,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: as

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: we have seen in the past. So it is your position that if you are President and Vice President, you have to divest from any and all businesses. Mas kinasari-sari store pa yan?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That is your position, ma'am?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And finally, ma'am, on SAL-N, pare-pareho lang po naman ng SAL-N ng Presidente, Vice, at ng bawat opisyal ng pamahalaan, di po ba?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Because there is a prescribed form by the Civil Service Commission.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Then why does the prescribed form mention business interest if it's prohibited from a president and vice president? It's the same form they fill up, ma'am. Why does it still include a blank for business interest if it's prohibited?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, it's a pro-form. It's a form that is prepared by the Civil Service Commission.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: All that the public, the president or vice president as the case may be, will do is to state they're not applicable, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Or umaasaan sa civil service na malay mo, madulas, magkamali, umamin. Meaning, there are only two officials, ma'am, president and vice president. I'm sure they can come up with a form for them specially. Wouldn't you think so? If at all for the future, if not now?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Perhaps, right? Because it's there. The blank is there to be filled up.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So ang ilalagay dapat na nun, ma'am, not applicable?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: If you're president and vice president?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: That would be all, Madam Justice. Senator-Judge Pia, Senator-Judge J.V. Ejercito, and then we break for lunch?

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: I thought there were no other senator-judges, that's why I already interjected.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes, Senator-Judge Pia.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: No, actually, mine

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: is just a follow-up to his Honor's question.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: Good afternoon, Justice. Good afternoon. Just a clarification on your response to the presiding officer. His earlier question was about the need to, if in your opinion, the president or vice president can hold on to stocks and receive dividends. And your answer was yes, they can receive dividends. You answered that earlier, hindi ba? Mr. Presiding Officer, can you confirm? She answered yes. Can I say something? Sure. I'll complete my question because precisely I want it clarified. And then in his succeeding question where we talked about divesting, sabi niyo they have to divest. So what would now be the difference between your first answer and your second answer? Because holding of stocks is also a form of ownership.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, regarding the receipt of dividends, if those dividends already accrued before assumption of office, then that becomes divested right of the stockholder. There

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: is

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: no legal prohibition to that.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: So ma'am, are you now clarifying your answer that If it was accrued prior to the assumption of office, then they may receive it, but upon assumption of office, they should be divesting of all kinds of investment, all stock ownerships.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Sen. Pia S. Cayetano
turns.text: So it doesn't matter if it is publicly listed, that you have no say, that you have shares that are just sitting there. Wala nang pinagkaiba yun sa closed corporations with limited stockholders. There's no difference in your opinion.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang

turns.text: clarify further, when used properly, impeachment is a tool for accountability. When abused, it is a tool for political retribution. It is only by compliance with the constitutional process that the proper balance between accountability and the ability of the public officers covered by impeachment to discharge their responsibilities can be respected. Impeachment is not a chance to settle political scores. Both the House of Representatives and the Senate have a responsibility to treat the impeachment process with seriousness, not as a chance to go after personalities or political opponents, but as a constitutional tool to address specific acts of misconduct. Allegations like corruption demand careful Evidence-based scrutiny. This process was never meant to be a stage for political theater or personal attacks. It is about determining whether a public official has committed actions that truly rise to the level of impeachable offenses as defined by the Constitution. When the focus shifts to the person rather than the alleged wrongdoing, the process loses its integrity. and impeachment risks becoming a blunt political weapon instead of a safeguard for public accountability. We reiterate, integrity is a constitutional imperative, but it applies to the impeachable officers as well as those involved in the constitutional process of impeaching and convicting for constitutionally provided offenses done in a constitutionally required manner. turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: No, but it's only the government official, sir, who is required to file a SAL-IN. And that public official is required to include the assets of his or her spouse. Correct.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: So, dapat alam niya lahat nung ari-arian, cash, at etc. nung asawa?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: paano kung hindi niya, let's say, hindi na-declare? May bank account ng asawa na hindi na-declare?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Well, kung hindi alam ng government official yung existing bank accounts ng kanyang asawa, I think there is one case where the Supreme Court accepted the explanation of the public official because how could he have declared that money which was unknown to him?

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: At acceptable ho yun?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes sir, because walang intentional concealment dyan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kung kung let's say sina Japong hindi i-declare, pwede po bang matanggal yung public official sa pwesto niya dahil hindi din-declare yung ari-arian ng asawa?

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Under RA 3019 Section 8, provided but after due proceedings, ma-establish nga na there was unlawful acquisition of unexplained wealth, pwede po yung maging In

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: short, even though sa asawa po yung non-declaration, pati yung public official ang pwedeng matanggal sa pwesto.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Basta, again, doon sa kaso po ng Rabusa versus Republic, kailan may pakita din nung asawa ng official na he or she was able to legitimately acquire those properties. Kung hindi niya may pakita, na wala siyang kakayanan financially to acquire those assets at saka yung ownership ng assets na yun ay traceable doon sa public official then that becomes the property of the public official.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Kasama na rin yung negosyo ng asawa. Let's say may negosyo ng asawa hindi din-declare doon ng public official so lahat po ng mga transactions

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: related to doon sa negosyo can affect the public official.

turns.speaker: Justice Amparo M. Cabotaje-Tang
turns.text: Yes, sir. Again, provided that the acquisition of those assets are traceable, yung ownership nun are traceable to the public official.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Thank

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
